power_bank.label: Consumer power bank
include: portable rechargeable battery used to charge consumer electronics
power bank with integrated charging cable
exclude: wall charger without an integrated battery

child_kick_scooter.label: Children's non-powered kick scooter
include: child-operated kick scooter propelled by pushing with one foot
two-wheel or three-wheel children's kick scooter
exclude: adult commuter scooter unless the recall explicitly includes children

residential_air_conditioner.label: Residential air conditioner
exclude: fan or air purifier without cooling
heat pump unless marketed as a residential air conditioner
